benchmark.title: Likho Urdu prosody annotation pilot, October 2026

scope.purpose: Exercise the annotation schema and review protocol on ten source-exact public-domain lines before corpus scale-up.
scope.formCoverage: Ten positive Ghalib lines across ramal, hazaj, rajaz, and khafeef. No rubai, no invalid variants, no repair tasks, and no contemporary writing.
limitations: One internal process prepared the annotations with engine output visible.
No independent qualified prosody reviewer or adjudicator has participated.
The pilot cannot support accuracy, coverage, or gold-benchmark claims.
Human minutes per item were not measured.
Current scan output exposes scansion patterns but not independent syllable-text segmentation.

reviewers.notes: Prepared the pilot with engine output visible; not a qualified independent prosody reviewer.

review.independenceStatement: No independent annotation or adjudication has occurred. One internal process prepared and checked every item with engine output visible. This pilot validates schema and tooling mechanics only.
limitations: Not an independent or double annotation.
No qualified prosody reviewer has signed the readings or meter assignments.
No item is a frozen gold answer.
Effort per item is unmeasured and must not be estimated from this pilot.

effortObservation.note: No independent human timing was performed. Do not infer minutes per item from this engine-assisted pilot.
